context_requirements: Expression of 11-beta hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase enzymes (HSD11B1 or HSD11B2) in the cell line
Availability of endogenous glucocorticoid substrate (cortisol/corticosterone) for the enzyme to act on
Functional glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1) signaling for downstream transcriptional effects
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after treatment with a selective 11-beta hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase inhibitor
Differential transcriptional response across the nine cell lines that correlates with HSD11B1 or HSD11B2 expression
Glucocorticoid-response element (GRE) signature changes (e.g., induction of known GR target genes) after treatment
